{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", data.shape)

print("\nUnique values in customer_age:", data['customer_age'].unique())

print("\nSample of revenue column:", data['revenue'].head(10).tolist())
print("Revenue data type:", data['revenue'].dtype)

# Check status column
print("\nUnique values in status:", data['status'].unique())

# Check channel and customer_segment
print("\nUnique values in channel:", data['channel'].unique())
print("Unique values in customer_segment:", data['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check for QA orders
print("\nCount of revenue == 999999.99:", (data['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check converted column
print("\nValue counts of converted:", data['converted'].value_counts())"}
